title: Algebraic characterisation of pseudo-elementary and second-order classes
summary: In this paper we provide purely model-theoretic (algebraic) characterisations for classes definable in second-order logic and for pseudo-elementary classes (including PC and PC_Δ classes). Classical results of this flavour include Keisler-Shelah type theorems (characterising first-order definability by closure under ultraproducts and ultraroots) and Birkhoff's HSP theorem; a key starting point for this paper is Sági's work, which provides an algebraic description of classes definable by existential second-order sentences.
